submission.label: latest-plan-20261005-local-gpu-20261006
submission.note: Latest plan/application, SAM3 acquisition tracker, current Clef serving tools and verified Live source, plus a standalone local NVIDIA GPU run/install path (deploy/local-gpu), assembled as one independent initial commit. Source revision strings below are attribution, not bundled Git history. Model weights and credentials are not included.
submission.repository: Independent Git repository; exactly one initial commit (this one); no development remote or shared object store. Public repository: https://github.com/Riey/synoptics

components.name: application (backend, web, visual-tools, scripts, build files, guide/plan/client docs)
components.source: worktree 'plan-usability' of the aisw-hybrid repository (a git worktree; the repository root is not in this export)

components.name: tracker service (SAM 3 image grounder + SAM 2.1 hiera_base_plus tracking)
components.note: TRACKER_GROUNDER=sam3 is required at runtime (the source default is 'gdino'); only tools/tracker_service/** and deploy/tracker/** are exported from this revision.

components.name: Clef fine-tune + serving toolchain (tools/clef_ft)
components.source: worktree 'clef-ft' revision fc0d0bc614aaff4cd7736baee0a9e21fe81aa44e (serve_clef.py, merge_ckpt.py and the multi-GPU/FP8 toolchain), with build_data.py and tests/test_build_data.py kept from the newest 'plan-usability' working tree (temporal_follow contextual-state support)
components.divergence: The clef-ft and plan-usability branches diverged inside tools/clef_ft. clef-ft adds the data-parallel (ftdist.py) training path, --evals-per-epoch / select-on orig / false-yes penalty, merge_ckpt.py + CLEF_WEIGHTS/CLEF_QUANT=fp8dyn serving, fp8_eval.py, nccl_check.py and their tests (all taken here). plan-usability's build_data.py adds temporal_context rows and is the newer file; its version does NOT carry clef-ft's --exclude/--flag CLI flags and per-row test_set field, which exist only in clef-ft's build_data.py.

The hash-verified patch output is exported instead.

components.name: submission runtime environment (.env.example, packaging-owned)
components.source: written by the export step; not copied from any worktree
components.note: Documents the current lanes with explicit blanks: TRACKER_GROUNDER=sam3, AISW_FOLLOW_PROVIDER=clef + the serve_clef.py CLEF_* keys, and AISW_TTS_URL=/LIVE_TTS_URL= empty so the only voice is the browser/device one. No credential is present; a blank key means the lane is off.

components.name: standalone local GPU server setup (deploy/local-gpu, packaging-owned)
components.source: written for this export; not copied from any worktree
components.note: setup.sh installs CPU and GPU runtimes (root .venv, live-api/.venv, .venv-clef, .venv-tracker, npm/web build, pinned SAM 2 source checkout) and never downloads weights or accepts licences; run.sh starts one foreground loopback service per terminal (tracker 8090, clef 8085, backend 8040, live 8104) and `run.sh check` exits non-zero unless all four health routes answer with their own keys and report ready. Model paths derive from MODEL_ROOT in the git-ignored .env.local-gpu; weights stay outside the repository.

runtime_requirements.python: 3.12+; dependencies in pyproject.toml + uv.lock (fastapi, httpx, pydantic, pillow, pypdf, uvicorn; pytest for the dev group)
runtime_requirements.node: npm workspace (root package.json/package-lock.json): typescript, json-schema-to-typescript; web/ adds react 19, vite 6, @vitejs/plugin-react
runtime_requirements.external_services: Actual model execution requires user API keys, a loopback SAM3/SAM2.1 tracker and the current Clef server. Example key files point to /dev/null; ambient credentials must be managed separately.

pinned_artifacts: SAM 3 model facebook/sam3 revision 3c879f39826c281e95690f02c7821c4de09afae7, checkpoint sha256 6d06f0a5f84e435071fe6603e61d0b4cc7b40e0d39d487cfd4d67d8cc11cc14a (gated on the Hub: weights must already be present in HF_HOME)

GroundingDINO (only used when TRACKER_GROUNDER is left at 'gdino') revision a2bb814dd30d776dcf7e30523b00659f4f141c71, checkpoint sha256 1a2412ef99bd74bcd3c2a246fa1e48581f8889a1300c9051974741314fc042f3
runtime_requirements.note: no model is downloaded at request time; the weights and the pinned source tree live on the GPU host's Docker-partition volume and are digest-checked before use

runtime_requirements.python: torch, transformers, fastapi, uvicorn, pillow; torchao 0.14.1 only for CLEF_QUANT=fp8dyn
runtime_requirements.artifacts: the release Clef backbone directory (CLEF_MODEL) plus an optional clef-ft checkpoint (CLEF_ADAPTER: adapter/ PEFT LoRA + head.safetensors, or CLEF_WEIGHTS: a pre-merged backbone produced by tools/clef_ft/merge_ckpt.py)

runtime_requirements.python: 3.12+; fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic, httpx, pillow (live-api/pyproject.toml + uv.lock); pytest + pytest-timeout for its tests
runtime_requirements.external: ffmpeg for WAV -> Ogg Opus/AAC (LIVE_FFMPEG); the application as LIVE_UPSTREAM_URL when LIVE_ENGINE=real

runtime_requirements.host: Linux x86_64, NVIDIA driver with CUDA 12.8 compatibility, Python 3.12 + uv, Node.js 24+/npm, git, gcc
runtime_requirements.python_envs: root .venv (backend), live-api/.venv (Live), .venv-clef and .venv-tracker (Python 3.12, torch 2.9.1/torchvision 0.24.1 from the cu128 wheel index, plus the same transformers 5.18.0 stack the fine-tuning script pins)
runtime_requirements.gpu_memory: Clef BF16 27B needs about 52 GiB of weights plus activations (one 80 GiB GPU, or split across several); the tracker (SAM 3 or GroundingDINO plus SAM 2.1 hiera_base_plus) fits one 24 GiB card. CLEF_QUANT=fp8dyn is a separate optional path requiring torchao.
runtime_requirements.note: weights, the c adapter, the SAM 2.1 checkpoint and gated SAM 3 access are prepared by the operator (MODELS.md); nothing is downloaded by setup.sh or at service start (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 default).

notes: Per-file sha256 of every exported file is in components[*].paths together with the manifest "files" map below; provenance for the clef toolchain is per file.

The Live server default for the voice lane is off: live-api/src/synoptics_live/settings.py sets tts_url=None and .env.local-gpu keeps AISW_TTS_URL/LIVE_TTS_URL empty, so only the browser/device speech path is used. OmniVoice implementation, weights and services are not part of this export.

The external client PWA (the collaborator's separate test client) is not in this repository and is therefore not part of this export; live-api/src/synoptics_live/static/index.html is the server-served reference client.

packaging_changes.documents: Current README/MODELS/API voice scope, latest evidence, and public Clef vendor license included; historical design/run documentation excluded.
packaging_changes.smoke_script: Copied current integration smoke; changed repository-relative location and proof output path only.
packaging_changes.voice: No speech-model implementation, checkpoints or training scripts. Live TTS URL defaults to None; generic protocol bridge remains optional/off, browser/device speech is default. Backend and Live public voice APIs checked without voice environment overrides.
packaging_changes.local_gpu: Added deploy/local-gpu (setup.sh, run.sh, .env.example, requirements-clef.txt, requirements-tracker.txt) with a standalone Linux+NVIDIA runbook in README.md/MODELS.md; removed stale internal host/port defaults from api-spec and the Live path-prefix default; ignored local env files, model weights and checkpoints.
packaging_changes.evidence: Added verification/local-gpu-checks.json recording the 2026-10-06 CPU-only install, GPU dependency resolution, regression suites, contracts regeneration and the offline Live-to-ASGI smoke.
packaging_changes.tailnet_scrub: Removed the internal tailnet hostname from the exported copies that still carried it: the tailnet authority literal in backend/tests/test_api.py (TAILNET) and the five occurrences in live-api/tests/test_rest.py (LIVE_PATH_PREFIXES host key and Host headers), plus the tunnel note in live-api/README.md.
